entries.zh: 悬望；悬念牵挂、切盼而焦急地等待
entries.en: to wait with anxiety/eagerness; to long for
entries.notes: 汉栏仅“懸”一字而闽南栏记三音节，字数不合；义据西栏 esperar con ansia 与“悬望/悬念”推断。

entries.zh: 等候；停留以待
entries.en: to wait; to stay and await
entries.notes: 闽南栏 “l.” 为原稿缩写（示另一读音），展开系推断，不影响本义。

entries.zh: 听候差遣，等候示下、待命
entries.en: to await (orders/instructions); to stand by

entries.zh: 伺候服侍，侍立等候
entries.en: to attend upon; to serve while waiting

entries.zh: 听任等候，坐候以待
entries.en: to wait for; to await

entries.zh: 随侍在侧，随行服侍等候
entries.en: to attend upon; to follow and serve in attendance

entries.zh: 伺候，等候并服侍左右
entries.en: to wait upon; to attend and await

entries.zh: 且慢，稍待片刻、劝人暂缓
entries.en: hold on a moment; wait a little
entries.notes: 第二字“謾/慢”存疑，取常语“且慢”义。

entries.zh: 稍停等候片刻、少待些时
entries.en: to wait a while; to stop briefly

entries.zh: 且宽几时，暂且宽限、再等些时
entries.en: to wait yet a while; to allow a short delay

entries.zh: 慢慢迁延时日、任其时日地久候
entries.en: to wait at length, letting time pass; to take one's time
entries.notes: 汉栏首字“謾/慢”存疑；西栏 Sto tiempo 疑为讹字（≈algún tiempo）；闽南栏另附第二读音，义未定。

entries.zh: 姑息，姑且宽容迁就、苟安一时
entries.en: to temporize; to bear with/indulge for the time being
entries.notes: 西栏讹字（necespario≈necesario）且闽南栏未竟；字“悉/息”存疑，取“姑息”义推断。

entries.zh: 瞻望，翘首远望以待
entries.en: to gaze/look out toward and await; to look forward to
entries.notes: 首字“瞻/膽”形近存疑，义取“瞻望”。

entries.zh: 仰望，仰首盼望、仰赖以待
entries.en: to look up to and await; to hope for from above

entries.zh: 冀望，指望、心存盼望而信待
entries.en: to hope for; to expect with desire and trust
entries.notes: 首字“翼/冀”存疑，取“冀望”义。

entries.zh: 候缺，待他人去任、空缺一出即行顶补
entries.en: to await a vacancy; to wait for another to finish his post so as to step in
entries.notes: 西栏缩写 off.≈oficio 且该句讹损，据“候缺”推断为候职任出缺。

entries.zh: 宽容容让，忍耐以待
entries.en: to bear with patience; to be forbearing

entries.zh: 留住不放，使人久候
entries.en: to keep (someone) waiting; to detain
entries.notes: 第二字“常/帶”存疑，义依首字“留”与西栏 hazerle esperar。

entries.zh: 待成功之日，等候事情办完
entries.en: to wait until something is done/accomplished; to await the day of completion

entries.zh: 怠慢，慢待轻忽使人久候
entries.en: to slight/keep (someone) waiting; to treat with neglect

entries.zh: 待时，等候时机、待时而动
entries.en: to bide one's time; to wait for the right moment
